title: Weber 2021 costal cartilage indentation modulus (overall and by direction)

quantity.name: indentation modulus
quantity.definition: Hertzian Young's modulus from spherical indentation (R 1.5 mm) at 5%, 10% and maximum strain

source.authors: Weber M, Rothschild MA, Niehoff A
source.sample: costal cartilage midsubstance (no perichondrium) from ribs 1-10 of 12 cadavers (forensic + body donor); unconfined compression 198 cylinders from 10 cadavers; indentation on 12

protocol.summary: Indentation: cartilage slices on rigid plate, rigid spherical steel indenter R=1.5 mm, preload 0.1 N at 0.05 mm/s, then 0.5 mm/s to 0.9 mm depth; Hertzian E (incompressible, nu=0.5) at 5%, 10% and maximum strain.
how_to_simulate: Model a cartilage slice indented by a 1.5 mm radius rigid sphere to 0.9 mm at 0.5 mm/s
Back-calculate Hertzian modulus at the stated strains

extraction.check_notes: Results text, mean +- SD (data not normally distributed; per-body median/IQR in Table 2 not extracted). doi printed. Discrepancy: Eimax 14.6 (abstract) vs 15.6 (Results). Directional rows: n per direction not stated in text.

pass_rule.rule: |model - mean| <= 1 SD (or inside [min, max] when no SD)
